title: Simply The Mods
body:
# Simply the Mods
### Simply the mods you need.

A no-frills, performance-first modpack for low-end PCs. Designed for players who just want to optimize vanilla Minecraft without any extras.

### 🚀 Why Simply the Mods?
Strictly optimization only no gameplay or quality-of-life changes

Super lightweight ideal for systems with limited resources

Fast load times and stable performance

### 💻 Minimum Requirements
✅ 4GB RAM

✅ Intel i3 or better

✅ No GPU needed (integrated graphics okay)

⚠️ SSD recommended

### 🔧 What’s Inside?
FPS boosters (like Sodium or alternatives)

Lag reduction and smoother chunk loading

Memory usage optimizations

Background process improvements

### 🧠 Who's It For?
Low-spec PC users

Players who want vanilla Minecraft to run better, not different

Modpack devs looking for a solid base to build on

No QoL. No fluff.
**_Simply the mods you need._**
